hints: Every leaf is already a valid heap of one element, so there is no point calling maxHeapify on any of them.
With n elements the leaves are exactly the indices from n/2 onwards, so the last node worth fixing is n/2 - 1.
Run the loop downwards, from n/2 - 1 to 0. maxHeapify requires its children to be valid already, so you must fix the bottom before the top.
title: buildMaxHeap: one loop, two decisions
